```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv("CDR_SoilBiomass_1982-2018_%C_preprocessed.csv")

summary(raw_data)
head(raw_data)

```

```{r}
new_data <- raw_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Plot, NAdd.g.m2.yr., X..Carbon) %>%
  filter(!is.na(X..Carbon)) %>% 
  group_by(Year, Plot, NAdd.g.m2.yr.) %>%
  summarise(PercentC = mean(X..Carbon)) 

write.csv(new_data, "CDR_SoilBiomass_1982-2018_%C_processed.csv")
```
